setInterval.title: Reporting interval
setInterval.description: Command 0x00. Reporting interval in seconds. Minimum 600 s (10 minutes).

pressureOffset.title: Pressure offset
pressureOffset.description: Command 0x02. Offset in inWC. The encoder sends the value in thousandths of inWC.

temperatureOffset.title: Probe temperature offset
temperatureOffset.description: Command 0x04. Offset in °F. The encoder sends the value in thousandths of °F.

humidityOffset.title: Humidity offset
humidityOffset.description: Command 0x06. Offset in %. The encoder sends the value in thousandths of %.

voltageOffset.title: Voltage offset
voltageOffset.description: Command 0x08. Offset in V. The encoder sends the value in thousandths of V.

currentOffset.title: Current offset
currentOffset.description: Command 0x0A. Offset in A. The encoder sends the value in thousandths of A.

humidityTempOffset.title: Humidity sensor temperature offset
humidityTempOffset.description: Command 0x0C. Offset in °F. The encoder sends the value in thousandths of °F.

gaugeDiffPressureOffset.title: Gauge or differential pressure offset
gaugeDiffPressureOffset.description: Command 0x10. Offset in PSI. The encoder sends the value in thousandths of PSI.
